Only pairs1+4 and2+3 have17 cells. Exhaustive enumeration of every placement under all eight grid isometries finds zero exact gap covers for1+4 and exactly one unordered geometric cover for2+3. The saved mathematical_audit.json contains all cells, pair counts and the actual2+3 witness. Hence C is unique. The local1 stair is genuinely identical to the marked source stair, and4 genuinely has the same two-unit endcap, but neither fact establishes a complete two-piece tiling.
